status: partial: crash-report downloads 1728 of 1729 (main queue) and 538 of 538 (extra NCAP side and pole tests) processed; tests not processed are not indexed. Compliance report text complete (scanned reports without a text layer are skipped, not OCRed)
source: NHTSA crash-test report PDFs (nrd-static.nhtsa.dot.gov): data sheet No. 1 (certification label GVWR/GAWR, seating, vehicle capacity weight, usable fuel tank capacity, weight as delivered by axle, wheelbase); NHTSA compliance test reports (static.nhtsa.gov/odi/ctr): FMVSS 110/138/537 placard and label block (GVWR/GAWR, occupant and cargo weight, seating total) and the FMVSS 135 brake test (cold-effectiveness stop from 100 km/h, maximum speed). Keys from vPIC DecodeVINValuesBatch of each test vehicle's own VIN.
rules: Values as printed in the report (unit kept); a field failing a plausibility rule (GVWR vs measured weight, GAWR sum vs GVWR, kg vs lb agreement, range checks) is left out, unless the cause is a unit mix-up (pounds under a kg heading or the reverse, US gallons under a litres heading) and exactly one corrected reading passes the measured-weight checks the printed one fails: then the value is kept with `unit` and a `correction` record of what was printed and what confirmed it. Accuracy: hand checks of 30 local and 20 server-extracted crash reports and 20 compliance reports, every FMVSS 135 value read by hand (research folder stage2/data/field_accuracy.json, ovsc/handcheck/verdicts.json).
